info.name: Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS) REST AutoREST Privileges API

description.content:
REST API for managing Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS) RESTful service definitions including modules, templates, handlers, privileges, roles, OAuth clients, and AutoREST-enabled objects. ORDS provides a mid-tier Java application that maps HTTP requests to database transactions, enabling RESTful access to Oracle Database resources. This specification covers the ORDS REST Services Management endpoints available through the Database API stable interface.
